ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 4

2. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

3. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

4. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 49

5. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 41
   C. 13
   D. 3

6. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

7. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 24

8. Solve for x: x + 8 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 10
   C. 17
   D. 9

9. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

10. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 25

11. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

12. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 21
   C. 17
   D. 3

13. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

14. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 122

15. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 29
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

16. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 18

17. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

18. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

19. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 13

20. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37

   C. 1
   D. 2
